text: Which substitution matrix is most appropriate for aligning two protein sequences that are highly divergent (only distantly related)?
explanation: BLOSUM50 is derived from more divergent alignment blocks, so lower-numbered BLOSUM matrices are the right choice for distant relatives, while BLOSUM80 is built for closely related sequences and BLOSUM62 is the general-purpose default. PAM1 represents only 1 accepted mutation per 100 residues, making it suited to very closely related sequences, not divergent ones — the PAM numbering scale runs the opposite direction from BLOSUM's.
